name: IBT-2 responds to the commanded duty within tolerance
measurement: pwm_applied_permille versus pwm_readback_permille on every frame, plus enable readback
known_defect_to_handle: enable_readback reports ren:0,len:0 in all 957 committed frames even while ren_command=1, so the driver enable state cannot be OBSERVED, only commanded; the method must not treat a matched duty number as proof the bridge switched

name: PZEM power behaviour is monotonic and interpretable at partial duty
measurement: median current and median power per duty level, with the latency frames excluded, over >= 3 repetitions per point
known_defect_to_handle: the PZEM integrates over its own cycle, so a PWM-fed branch's 'power' is a mean whose semantics versus duty are exactly what docs/01 section 48 requires characterization to establish

name: thermal behaviour stays inside the resolved hot-side limit with margin
measurement: TEC_HOT_SIDE (as-built T2) plateau per duty point, plus chamber response, never averaged across roles
known_defect_to_handle: no continuous rating exists, the 55 C ceiling was provisional, and no cold-side/junction channel exists in any capture

name: component temperatures (terminals, IBT-2 case, conductor) stay inside their ratings at every duty point
measurement: touch-free temperature at fixed checkpoints during the dwell
known_defect_to_handle: nothing in any recorded frame measures this; it is the same gap that keeps A-W08-03 open

name: energy feature is worth its resolution cost
measurement: energy_wh counter steps per dwell against the dwell length
known_defect_to_handle: the counter is 1 Wh quantised and carries no validity token at all; at ~85 W it updates about every 42 s, so a short dwell gives it nothing to resolve

name: fuse/conductor coordination survives the duty points actually used
measurement: observed peak and sustained current per point against the installed conductor's ampacity basis
known_defect_to_handle: W08 returns NO_FREEZE: the installed branch has no recorded ampacity basis (a 1.75 mm core diameter is ~2.405 mm2 only if it is round solid) and the fuse marking was never photographed, the 15 A being operator-reported only
